repos_data.description: ⚙️ Convert HTML to Markdown. Even works with entire websites and can be extended through rules.

Fast, lightweight Firecrawl/Tavily alternative in Rust. Web scraper, crawler & search API with MCP server for AI agents. Drop-in Firecrawl-compatible API (/scrape, /crawl, /search). 2.3x faster than Tavily, 1.5x faster than Firecrawl in 1K-URL benchmarks. 6 MB RAM, single binary. Self-host or use managed cloud.
Local-first MCP server and CLI in Rust: any page as LLM-ready Markdown, whole-site crawls, keyless search, and local captcha solving. No cloud, no API keys.
Parses a web page into the exact format a decision model needs: dates as dates, numbers with units, chunks that fit the model's window. MCP server + TypeScript library, no model or API key required.
Octocrawl: readable Markdown and checked fields from public web pages, for AI agents, RAG and research. Failures come back with a reason. Self-host with REST, SDK or MCP.

MCP server that converts any web page URL to clean Markdown for LLM context. Fetches HTML from the URL you pass in, converts locally, SSRF-guarded. No external APIs, no telemetry. For Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed.
